verdict.rationale: A keyless probe found a public OpenAPI 3.1 spec of about 405 paths (auth, users, apple-messages and more) with Swagger UI at /docs, so a broad machine-readable backend API exists. But the probe notes that no developer program or public API keys are documented, and nothing confirms the API is supported for third-party use or matches the UI feature for feature. missing for 10: documented public API access/keys, explicit API–UI parity claim, developer docs covering agent features (briefings, scheduled jobs, website publishing) via API, independent hands-on use of the API.
